# N03 scaffold: pyproject, cli dispatcher + stubs, AGENTS.md, LICENSE
Do: Create the project skeleton so later nodes each own disjoint files. A dispatcher registers every command from
its own module; every command module is a stub until its node fills it. The kit tree exists with placeholder files
at their final names so install and package data work before the kit is written.
Context: D4 Python >= 3.10, stdlib only at runtime; pytest + ruff as a uv dev group, never shipped. D5 src layout
`src/planzilla/`, hatchling, version 0.1.0 in `src/planzilla/__init__.py` (`__version__`, read by hatch), author
"Reza Maghoul" (no email), license Apache-2.0, scripts `planzilla` and `plz` -> `planzilla.cli:main`. D24 rules
go in `AGENTS.md`: strict TDD, stdlib only, pure core (parse, state, waves) with IO in `commands/`, one module per
command, KISS/YAGNI, type hints, `today`/`now` passed in; `CLAUDE.md` contains only `@AGENTS.md`.
Dispatcher contract: `cli.py` holds an ordered list of command names; each `commands/<name>.py` exposes
`add_arguments(parser)` and `run(args) -> int`. Stubs print `not implemented: <name>` to stderr and return 2.
Commands: install, next, set, resume, brief, log, check, commit, status, stats, lint, serve (FORMAT §9).
Kit placeholders (one line each, final names per FORMAT §11): `src/planzilla/kit/roles/{planner,executor,verifier,
visual}.md`, `kit/templates/*` as named in FORMAT §11, `kit/agents/claude/plz-{planner,executor,verifier,visual}.md`,
`kit/skills/plz-new-plan/SKILL.md`, `kit/skills/plz-run-plan/SKILL.md`, and the AGENTS.md block file of §11.
LICENSE: the canonical Apache-2.0 text downloaded verbatim from https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.txt
(curl or urllib; D23 pre-authorizes it); never typed from memory. This node writes nothing under `.claude/` (D25).
Read: `docs/FORMAT.md` §9, §11
Write: `pyproject.toml`, `uv.lock`, `.gitignore`, `.python-version`, `LICENSE`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`,
`src/planzilla/__init__.py`, `src/planzilla/__main__.py`, `src/planzilla/cli.py`, `src/planzilla/commands/**`,
`src/planzilla/kit/**`, `tests/__init__.py`, `tests/commands/__init__.py`, `tests/kit/__init__.py`,
`tests/conftest.py`, `tests/test_cli.py`
Log: append only to `.plan/2026-10-01-planzilla-v1/log/N03.md` (never a repo-root `log/`)
Test first: `tests/test_cli.py`: `python -m planzilla --help` lists all 12 commands; `--version` prints 0.1.0;
each stub command exits 2 with `not implemented: <name>`.
Done when:
- C1 [cmd] `uv sync && uv run pytest -q tests/test_cli.py`
- C2 [cmd] `uv run planzilla --version | grep -qx '.*0\.1\.0' && uv run plz --help >/dev/null`
- C3 [cmd] `grep -q 'Version 2.0, January 2004' LICENSE && grep -q 'END OF TERMS AND CONDITIONS' LICENSE`
- C4 [cmd] `test "$(cat CLAUDE.md)" = "@AGENTS.md"`
- C5 [review] pyproject declares no runtime dependencies, requires-python >= 3.10, ruff and pytest only in a dev
  group; AGENTS.md states every D24 rule in at most 30 lines
- C6 [review] every kit placeholder path matches FORMAT §11 exactly; `.gitignore` covers `.venv/`, `dist/`,
  `__pycache__/`
- C7 [cmd] `uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run pytest -q`
